name: progressive-blur
title: Progressive Blur
description: Native custom element that stacks masked backdrop-blur layers to create a directional progressive blur.

usage.label: Astro
usage.code:
---
import "@/components/motion-kit/progressive-blur-element.ts";
---

<motion-progressive-blur
  direction="bottom"
  blur-layers="7"
  blur-intensity="1"
  fade-color="#17181A"
  class="w-full h-[200px]"
/>

usage.label: React
Vue
usage.code:
<script setup>
import "@/components/motion-kit/progressive-blur-element.ts";
</script>

<template>
  <motion-progressive-blur
    direction="bottom"
    blur-layers="7"
    blur-intensity="1"
    fade-color="#17181A"
    class="w-full h-[200px]"
  />
</template>

usage.label: HTML
usage.code:
<script type="module" src="/components/motion-kit/progressive-blur-element.js"></script>

<motion-progressive-blur
  direction="bottom"
  blur-layers="7"
  blur-intensity="1"
  fade-color="#17181A"
  class="w-full h-[200px]"
/>

props.name: direction
props.description: Direction of the blur gradient: 'top', 'right', 'bottom', or 'left'.

props.name: blur-layers
props.description: Number of blur layers (2-7, more layers = smoother gradient).

props.name: blur-intensity
props.description: Multiplier for the blur strength of each layer.

props.name: fade-color
props.description: Optional color to fade into at the end of the blur gradient.
